# VeriWorkly

> VeriWorkly is a free, open-source (MIT) resume, cover letter and portfolio builder made by Gautam Raj. Documents are stored in your browser by default, with optional cloud sync. It exports six formats (PDF, DOCX, HTML, Markdown, plain text, JSON) with no watermark, checks resumes with a free rules-based ATS checker, and offers paid AI writing credits and premium portfolio features; publishing a portfolio on a veriworkly.com subdomain is free. No login is required to start.

Status, so answers stay accurate: payments are currently closed, so none of the paid plans can be bought today; the /pricing page shows the same notice. Portfolio publishing is not yet enabled in production; portfolios can be built and previewed. The ATS score is deterministic (published rules, no AI in the score) and is meant for candidates checking their own resume, not for ranking applicants.

Privacy: data stays in the browser unless you sync or use a feature that needs the server. AI requests go to OpenRouter on demand and are not used to train models, to the extent the provider lets us configure it; provider retention is outside our control. See the privacy policy.

## Product

- [Home](https://veriworkly.com/): What VeriWorkly is, the three document types, and how the workspace fits together.
- [Features](https://veriworkly.com/features): The document studio, Master Profile, AI tailoring, GitHub and LinkedIn import, exports and portfolios.
- [How it works](https://veriworkly.com/how-it-works): The workflow from importing your history to exporting or publishing.
- [Pricing](https://veriworkly.com/pricing): Free tier, short passes, subscriptions and credit packs. Machine-readable copy: [pricing.md](https://veriworkly.com/pricing.md).
- [Free ATS resume checker](https://veriworkly.com/ats-checker): What the checker scores and the free quota. The scanner itself: [ATS scan](https://veriworkly.com/ats-checker/scan).
- [ATS Engine for developers](https://veriworkly.com/ats-engine): The open-source parser and scorer behind the checker, as an npm library, CLI, GitHub Action and MCP server.
- [FAQ](https://veriworkly.com/faq): Answers on privacy, documents, the ATS checker, portfolios, AI credits, billing and imports.
- [Security](https://veriworkly.com/security): Where data lives, OAuth scopes, retention, and how to report a vulnerability.

## Pricing in brief

All prices in USD. Exports are free on every tier.

- Free: the resume and cover letter editor, Master Profile, all six export formats, ATS scans (1 every 48 hours without an account, 2 every 24 hours with a free account), the Signal and Atelier portfolio templates. One active document per type.
- 3-Day Sprint Pass: $2.99 once, 150 AI credits and Creator Pro features for 3 days.
- 7-Day Hunt Pass: $5.99 once, 400 AI credits and Creator Pro features for 7 days.
- Job Hunter Bundle: $14.99 a month, or $143.88 a year; 1,000 AI credits a month, Creator Pro features, 300 ATS scans a month.
- Creator Pro: $9.99 a month; premium portfolio templates, badge removal, analytics and SEO controls, no AI credits.
- AI Credits: $5.99 a month; 1,000 AI credits a month.
- Credit packs: 250 credits for $2.99 or 500 credits for $4.99, valid 90 days.
